decisions: Clarify whether the buyer means product wrapping, retail packaging, mailer packaging, paper bags or protective inner packaging.
Prepare product dimensions, material direction, print coverage, quantity range, artwork status and target sales channel before RFQ.
Avoid generic price requests; define the exact packaging role first so supplier review is useful.
